findings.quoted_text: Attrition is measured on a night-by-night basis, with shortfalls calculated by comparing actual rooms occupied to the block size on each night of the event period. Group shall be deemed in attrition if actual occupancy falls below the attrition threshold of ninety percent (90%) on any night.
findings.headline: Night-by-night attrition with 90% trigger
findings.finding_text: Night-by-night measurement and a 90% trigger expose the group to damages on any single soft night.
findings.cd_standard: Cumulative measurement; 70% of block trigger.
findings.proposed_language: Attrition is measured on a cumulative basis across the entire room block, not night by night. Group shall be deemed in attrition only if actual pickup falls below seventy percent (70%) of the total contracted room block.
findings.redline_note: Measures attrition across the whole block with a lower trigger.
findings.compromise_range: Trigger up to 80% of the block, still measured cumulatively. Damages up to 80% of the single net group rate.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group's occupancy fall below ninety percent (90%) on any night during the event period, Group shall be liable for attrition damages at the rate of one hundred percent (100%) of the nightly room rate for each unoccupied room within the block.
findings.headline: Attrition charged at full room rate per night
findings.finding_text: Damages at 100% of rate per night overcharge versus lost profit.
findings.cd_standard: 70% of single net group rate on unsold rooms below 70% of block.
findings.proposed_language: Should Group's cumulative pickup fall below seventy percent (70%) of the total contracted room block, Group shall be liable for attrition damages equal to seventy percent (70%) of the single confirmed net group rate for each unsold room night below that threshold, calculated as the lesser of the number of unsold rooms in the Hotel that night or the shortfall between Group's minimum block and actual pickup. After receipt of this payment, Hotel will not seek additional damages related to the room block commitment. Any excess food and beverage revenue above Group's minimum will be credited dollar for dollar against room attrition damages. Should a ConferenceDirect client rebook the Hotel within three (3) years, Hotel will credit up to 100% of the damages paid toward the new booking's room revenue; if the rebooking group is not the group that paid, the credit will be refunded to the group that paid.
findings.redline_note: Sets damages on lost profit with settlement and rebooking credit.
findings.compromise_range: Trigger up to 80% of the block, still measured cumulatively. Damages up to 80% of the single net group rate.

findings.quoted_text: Group shall receive no credit toward its block commitment for nights on which the Hotel sells out all available rooms in the Hotel, and occupancy on such nights shall be deemed to have satisfied the threshold regardless of the actual number of rooms occupied from the block.
findings.headline: No block credit for sold-out nights
findings.finding_text: Sold-out nights should give full credit toward the block.
findings.cd_standard: Full credit for any night at 95%+ occupancy.
findings.proposed_language: For any night the Hotel achieves ninety-five percent (95%) occupancy or higher, Group shall receive full credit toward its block commitment for that night.
findings.redline_note: Gives block credit on nights the hotel is nearly full.
findings.compromise_range: Trigger up to 80% of the block, still measured cumulatively. Damages up to 80% of the single net group rate.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel's occupancy records, registration cards, and room-by-room occupancy logs shall not be open to Group for audit, verification, or inspection, and Group waives any right to independently verify the Hotel's calculations or to contest the Hotel's occupancy records on any basis.
findings.headline: Group barred from auditing attrition records
findings.finding_text: No audit right leaves discretionary calculation unverifiable.
findings.cd_standard: Audit rights; formula-based damages.
findings.proposed_language: At Group's request, Hotel will provide a copy of its city ledger or daily report showing the information needed to verify the calculation, and Group may verify the Hotel's calculations.
findings.redline_note: Lets the group verify the attrition calculation.
findings.compromise_range: Trigger up to 80% of the block, still measured cumulatively. Damages up to 80% of the single net group rate.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group cancel this agreement at any time after execution by the parties, Group shall be liable to the Hotel for liquidated damages calculated as a percentage of gross room revenue that would have been earned by the Hotel for all guest rooms for all nights within the event period of April 12-16, 2027, based upon the negotiated room rate and the full room block size.
findings.headline: Cancellation damages on gross revenue, full block
findings.finding_text: Damages should be on room profit, less allowable attrition.
findings.cd_standard: 70% of single net group rate times adjusted block less allowable attrition.
findings.proposed_language: Should Group cancel this agreement at any time after execution by the parties, Group shall be liable to the Hotel for liquidated damages calculated as a percentage of room profit on the sliding scale below, with the dollar amount owed at each tier stated in this Agreement. One hundred percent (100%) of room profit is seventy percent (70%) of the confirmed single net group rate at the time of cancellation, multiplied by the final adjusted room block less allowable attrition.
findings.redline_note: Bases cancellation damages on room profit with dollar tiers stated.
findings.compromise_range: Room profit up to 80% of the single net group rate. Keep the sliding scale and the hotel's duty to resell.

findings.quoted_text: Group shall not receive credit toward damages owed for any revenue the Hotel subsequently earns from reselling cancelled rooms or function space, as the Hotel's ability to generate such resale revenue is contingent on market conditions beyond the Hotel's control and shall be retained entirely by the Hotel.
findings.headline: No credit for resale proceeds on cancellation
findings.finding_text: Hotel keeps resale revenue and full damages.
findings.cd_standard: Mitigation credit.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will undertake all reasonable efforts to resell canceled rooms and food and beverage functions, and will credit those revenues against the cancellation damages, not to exceed the full amount of such damages.
findings.redline_note: Credits resale revenue against cancellation damages.
findings.compromise_range: Room profit up to 80% of the single net group rate. Keep the sliding scale and the hotel's duty to resell.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group elect to rebook with the Hotel at a later date following cancellation of this agreement, such rebooking shall constitute a new and separate commitment and shall earn Group no credit, offset, or other financial benefit against damages that accrued under this cancellation provision prior to the rebooking.
findings.headline: No credit when group rebooks after cancelling
findings.finding_text: Rebooking earns no credit for damages paid.
findings.cd_standard: Rebooking credit within 3 years.
findings.proposed_language: Should a ConferenceDirect client rebook the Hotel for another meeting within three (3) years, Hotel will credit up to 100% of the cancellation damages paid toward the new booking's room revenue, not to exceed the damages paid; if the rebooking group is not the group that paid, the credit will be refunded directly to the group that paid.
findings.redline_note: Credits damages paid toward a later rebooking.
findings.compromise_range: Room profit up to 80% of the single net group rate. Keep the sliding scale and the hotel's duty to resell.

findings.quoted_text: The shortfall payment rate shall be one hundred percent (100%) of the difference between the minimum guarantee and actual consumption.
findings.headline: Food and beverage shortfall is charged at 100%, above the 35% standard
findings.finding_text: Raised by the app from the contract's numbers. The group pays 100% of a food and beverage shortfall. The standard is 35%. Check any dollar amount the contract states beside this percentage, since the wording below changes the percentage alone.
findings.cd_standard: Food and beverage minimums should lock in menu pricing no earlier than 12 months before the event (or at a named year's pricing), and any shortfall should be billed at a fraction of the gap, not the full difference — CD's own contract asks for 35% of the shortfall, well below a dollar-for-dollar penalty. Food and beverage revenue from affiliate organizations and exhibitors should count toward the minimum.
findings.proposed_language: The shortfall payment rate shall be thirty-five percent (35%) of the difference between the minimum guarantee and actual consumption.
findings.compromise_range: Shortfall billed at 35–50% of the gap. Menu pricing locked 6–12 months before arrival.

findings.quoted_text: Reservations for rooms within the block committed for the National Association of Coastal Engineers event shall be accepted by the Hotel only when received on or before forty-five (45) days prior to the arrival date of April 12, 2027. This cutoff date is firm and is established to allow the Hotel adequate time to manage inventory, coordinate staffing, and finalize event logistics. Reservations requested after this cutoff date shall be handled exclusively through the Hotel's reservations department and shall not be processed as group reservations subject to the group rate negotiated for this event.
findings.headline: Cutoff set well before the 21-day standard
findings.finding_text: A 45-day cutoff is further out than 21 days, leaving attendees less time to book at the group rate.
findings.cd_standard: Cutoff 21 days or fewer before arrival.
findings.proposed_language: The cutoff date for the room block will be no earlier than twenty-one (21) days prior to Group's major arrival date of April 12, 2027. Reservations for rooms within the block committed for the National Association of Coastal Engineers event shall be accepted by the Hotel through that date.
findings.redline_note: Moves the cutoff later so attendees have more time to reserve.
findings.compromise_range: 21–30 days before arrival.

findings.quoted_text: Any reservation request received after the cutoff date of forty-five (45) days prior to arrival shall be offered accommodations, if available, only at the Hotel's prevailing rack rate in effect at the time of booking, with no access to the negotiated group rate regardless of the reason for the late request.
findings.headline: Rack rate only after cutoff; no unassigned-room handling
findings.finding_text: Post-cutoff attendees lose the group rate immediately and the contract has no mechanism for rooms left unassigned at cutoff, increasing attrition exposure.
findings.cd_standard: Group rate continues while Hotel sells to the public; unassigned rooms held on prepayment, refunded, or resold after consultation.
findings.proposed_language: After the cutoff date, Hotel will continue to hold any rooms in Group's block not assigned to a specific attendee if Group pays for them in full at that time, and will refund those advance payments after the Event for any such rooms later paid for by Group attendees; alternatively, after consultation with Group, Hotel will offer unassigned rooms to other individuals or groups to reduce any damages Group may owe under the attrition clause. Group members may continue to reserve rooms at the group rate for as long as Hotel is selling rooms to the general public, regardless of room type; once the room block has sold, Hotel will honor the group rate for as long as it is selling the contracted room type to the general public.
findings.redline_note: Keeps the group rate available after cutoff and addresses rooms not yet assigned.
findings.compromise_range: 21–30 days before arrival.

findings.quoted_text: In the event the Hotel is unable to provide accommodations to any guest for whom a reservation has been guaranteed under this Agreement, the Hotel shall make a reasonable effort to secure alternative lodging at the guest's sole expense and cost.
findings.headline: Walked guests pay for their own alternate lodging
findings.finding_text: The guest bears all relocation cost; no advance contact, walk order, do-not-walk list, or additional compensation for large walks.
findings.cd_standard: Advance contact, transient guests walked first, do-not-walk list, comparable hotel at Hotel's expense, additional compensation for 10+ guests or 10% of peak block.
findings.proposed_language: If Hotel is unable to accommodate any member of Group holding a confirmed reservation, Hotel will contact Group in advance, will not walk members of Group before transient guests and other groups, and will review Group's attendee list with Group to identify those who cannot be walked under any circumstances. For each displaced guest, Hotel will, at its own expense, provide accommodations at a comparable hotel as close as possible, at no charge to the guest, for each night the guest is displaced. If Hotel walks ten (10) or more guests, or ten percent (10%) or more of the contracted peak-night block, Hotel will owe Group reasonable additional compensation.
findings.redline_note: Places relocation cost and process on the Hotel and protects key attendees.

findings.quoted_text: All transportation to and from any alternative hotel, including airport transfers, shall be the guest's own responsibility and expense, and the Hotel shall have no obligation to arrange, provide, or reimburse for any transportation costs incurred by the guest.
findings.headline: No transportation for relocated guests
findings.finding_text: Walked guests pay for their own transport to and from the alternate hotel, and messages are not forwarded.
findings.cd_standard: Round-trip transportation and message forwarding at Hotel's expense.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will, at its own expense, provide complimentary round-trip ground transportation between the Hotel and the alternate hotel for each day the guest is displaced, and will forward the displaced guest's telephone messages, mail, and packages.
findings.redline_note: Hotel provides transport and message forwarding for relocated guests.

findings.quoted_text: Upon the Group's return to the Harborview Grand Hotel following any relocation, the relocated guest shall be assigned to a standard guest room without any upgrade, suite premium, room enhancement, or additional amenity as compensation for the inconvenience of relocation. The guest shall receive no reduction in room rate, no complimentary services, and no credit toward future stays.
findings.headline: No upgrade, amenity or rebate for walked guests
findings.finding_text: Returning guests get no upgrade or amenity and the Group receives no per-night rebate.
findings.cd_standard: Upgrade if available and GM welcome amenity on return; per-night credit to master account.
findings.proposed_language: When the guest returns, Hotel will provide upgraded accommodations if available and a welcome amenity from the General Manager. Hotel will credit Group's master account $200 for each night a guest is relocated, regardless of that guest's rate.
findings.redline_note: Adds upgrade, amenity and a master account credit for each relocated night.

findings.quoted_text: Each night during which a guest's guaranteed reservation was relocated to an alternative hotel shall not be credited toward the Group's room pickup, occupancy count, or commission calculation, and such nights shall be excluded entirely from all metrics used to measure the Group's performance under the terms of this Agreement.
findings.headline: Relocated nights excluded from pickup and commission
findings.finding_text: Walked nights reduce pickup, exposing Group to attrition for rooms the Hotel failed to provide, and cut commission.
findings.cd_standard: Relocated nights credited to pickup and commissionable; no attrition liability for any walked night.
findings.proposed_language: Each displaced room will be credited toward Group's final pickup and remain commissionable at the group rate, and Group will not be liable for attrition damages if any guest is walked on any night.
findings.redline_note: Counts relocated nights toward pickup and removes attrition for walked nights.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel reserves the right to impose additional fees, surcharges, and service charges upon Group at any time, including without limitation after the execution of this Agreement. Such fees and surcharges may include, without limitation, facility fees, energy surcharges, sustainability fees, labor surcharges, and other operational charges that the Hotel may add at its discretion. Group shall pay all such fees as added to its bills, whether or not such fees were disclosed prior to Group's signature on this Agreement.
findings.headline: Hotel may add undisclosed fees after signing
findings.finding_text: Open-ended right to add fees at any time with no disclosure or approval.
findings.cd_standard: All charges disclosed before signature; undisclosed charges waived; later add-ons need written approval.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will disclose in writing, prior to execution of this Agreement, all charges that may be associated with the Event based on the meeting requirements provided by Group, including but not limited to resort fees, surcharges, shipping and delivery charges, electrical charges, telephone access charges, porterage, rigging, signage, sponsorship or conference branding and marketing, and meeting setup or rental charges. Any charge not disclosed to Group in writing prior to signature is waived. Should Group require additional services or equipment after signature, Hotel must obtain Group's written approval before providing the service and before posting the charge to the master account.
findings.redline_note: Requires advance written disclosure and approval of charges.

findings.quoted_text: All fees and surcharges, whether pre-disclosed or introduced after execution, shall be due and payable by Group. Group waives any claim that undisclosed charges are unenforceable or that such charges constitute a material modification of the Agreement. The Hotel's right to add fees shall not be limited by prior disclosures or the absence thereof.
findings.headline: Group waives objection to undisclosed charges
findings.finding_text: Group pays undisclosed charges and waives claims against them, defeating disclosure protections.
findings.cd_standard: Undisclosed charges waived outright.
findings.proposed_language: All fees and surcharges disclosed in writing prior to execution of this Agreement shall be due and payable by Group as described. Any fee or surcharge not so disclosed is waived.
findings.redline_note: Limits payable fees to those disclosed before signing.

findings.quoted_text: A resort fee of $35.00 per occupied room per night shall be charged to all rooms in the block. This resort fee is in addition to all room rates and shall be applied to every room night, including complimentary room nights that Group may receive. The resort fee shall be invoiced monthly and shall be due within thirty (30) days of invoice date.
findings.headline: Resort fee charged on every room including complimentary
findings.finding_text: Attendees pay the resort fee on all rooms, including complimentary rooms, with no waiver.
findings.cd_standard: Resort fee waived for attendees with services honored; no early check-in or bag fees.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will waive the resort fee for all attendees while continuing to honor the resort fee services. Hotel will not charge attendees an early check-in fee when their room type is available, and will waive checked-bag fees for attendees arriving before check-in time or departing after check-out time.
findings.redline_note: Waives the resort fee while keeping its services, and removes early check-in and bag fees.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall provide complimentary room nights to Group based on a ratio of one (1) complimentary room per seventy-five (75) paid room nights occupied during the Event Period.
findings.headline: Complimentary room ratio is weaker than 1:40
findings.finding_text: One per 75 paid nights is a thinner formula than one per 40 occupied revenue-producing nights.
findings.cd_standard: One complimentary room per 40 occupied room nights, cumulative.
findings.proposed_language: Group will receive one (1) complimentary room for every forty (40) occupied, revenue-producing room nights actualized, calculated cumulatively across the entire room block (total room nights divided by 40), regardless of whether the contracted block was otherwise met.
findings.redline_note: Sets a clearer, cumulative complimentary room formula.
findings.compromise_range: One complimentary room per 40–50 occupied room nights.

findings.quoted_text: The complimentary room ratio of seventy-five (75) stated above is a guideline only and does not create an entitlement in Group. The award and allocation of any complimentary rooms shall be at the sole and absolute discretion of the Hotel, and the Hotel may elect to award fewer complimentary rooms than the guideline ratio would suggest or may decline to award complimentary rooms altogether. The Hotel may withdraw or reduce complimentary room credits at any time without notice. Group waives any claim for complimentary rooms in excess of those actually awarded by the Hotel.
findings.headline: Complimentary rooms are discretionary and revocable
findings.finding_text: The ratio is a guideline only; Hotel may withhold or withdraw rooms, and no-show or cancellation fees earn no pickup credit.
findings.cd_standard: Clear formula; all occupied rooms and each no-show/cancellation fee counted; complimentary internet regardless of loyalty status.
findings.proposed_language: All occupied rooms will be counted toward Group's pickup, including rooms credited to Group through a room block audit. Each no-show fee and each cancellation fee charged will be credited as one (1) room night toward Group's pickup and used in calculating complimentary rooms and rebates. Hotel will provide complimentary internet in attendees' guest rooms, regardless of brand loyalty program participation.
findings.redline_note: Makes complimentary rooms an entitlement and counts all occupied rooms.
findings.compromise_range: One complimentary room per 40–50 occupied room nights.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group fail to meet its room block commitment during the Event Period, all complimentary room credits earned under this clause shall be forfeited in their entirety. Attrition shall be measured by comparing the actual room nights occupied to the room block specified in this Agreement. If actual occupancy falls below one hundred percent (100%) of the block, Group shall lose all complimentary room benefits, and the Hotel shall be relieved of any obligation to provide or credit complimentary rooms. Any forfeiture of complimentary rooms shall not reduce Group's other obligations to the Hotel.
findings.headline: Any shortfall below full block forfeits all complimentary rooms
findings.finding_text: The forfeiture threshold of 100% of the block is stricter than the 90% attrition threshold, so Group loses concessions and also pays attrition for the same shortfall.
findings.cd_standard: Complimentary rooms earned regardless of whether the block was met; not forfeited for attrition already compensated elsewhere.
findings.proposed_language: Complimentary rooms earned under this clause will not be forfeited or reduced by any shortfall against the room block, which is addressed solely under the attrition clause.
findings.redline_note: Removes the loss of earned complimentary rooms for block shortfalls.
findings.compromise_range: One complimentary room per 40–50 occupied room nights.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel makes no representation, warranty, or guarantee regarding the status, scope, timing, or impact of any construction, renovation, maintenance, or capital improvement work that may be planned, in progress, or completed during the dates of the Event or at any time during the term of this Agreement. The Hotel shall not be obligated to disclose to the Group the existence of, the nature of, or any details concerning any such work, whether affecting guest rooms, public spaces, or the exterior of the Hotel property.
findings.headline: No renovation representation or disclosure
findings.finding_text: Hotel gives no representation about renovations and need not disclose any work.
findings.cd_standard: No-plans representation; 30 days' written notice with scope, schedule, impact and mitigation plan.
findings.proposed_language: As of the date of this Agreement, Hotel has no plans for renovation or remodeling of any facilities to be used by Group, other than ordinary maintenance. If Hotel later confirms any such plans, Hotel will notify Group in writing within thirty (30) days, describing: (a) the planned scope of the project; (b) the schedule for commencement and completion; (c) the anticipated impact on areas Group will use; and (d) Hotel's plan for minimizing that impact.
findings.redline_note: Adds a renovation representation and written notice of later plans.
findings.compromise_range: Written notice within 30–60 days of plans being confirmed.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel reserves the right to commence, continue, or complete any construction, renovation, or maintenance work at any time without providing the Group with advance written notice, and without restriction as to timing, scope, noise level, dust, disruption to guest services, or impact on guest experience. No work order, contractor engagement, or project timeline shall be subject to the Group's approval or consent.
findings.headline: Hotel may renovate at will with no interference limits
findings.finding_text: Unrestricted work with no notice or limit on disruption to the event.
findings.cd_standard: Hotel promises work will not interfere; parties negotiate in good faith.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel promises that any such construction or remodeling will not interfere with Group's use of the Hotel, and the parties will negotiate in good faith to resolve any concerns and amend this Agreement as needed.
findings.redline_note: Commits that any work will not interfere with the group's use.
findings.compromise_range: Written notice within 30–60 days of plans being confirmed.

findings.quoted_text: In the event that any construction, renovation, maintenance, or capital improvement work interferes with, disrupts, diminishes, or otherwise affects the Group's occupancy, the use and enjoyment of the Hotel's facilities, or the quality of service or accommodations provided to the Group's guests, such work shall not constitute grounds for the Group to terminate this Agreement, to claim damages or loss of value, to demand a rate reduction or credit, or to pursue any other remedy or relief against the Hotel. The Group's obligations under this Agreement shall remain in full force and effect notwithstanding any such interference or disruption.
findings.headline: No remedy or exit if renovation disrupts the event
findings.finding_text: Group must perform in full despite disruption and cannot terminate.
findings.cd_standard: Group may terminate without liability if it determines work will interfere; new-build opening commitments.
findings.proposed_language: If Group determines the construction or remodeling will interfere with its meeting, Group may terminate this Agreement without liability upon written notice given within thirty (30) days of receiving Hotel's plans. For a new build or a hotel reopening after closure, Hotel confirms that all facilities will be open and fully operational no later than ninety (90) days before Group's arrival, and will notify Group in writing within five (5) business days of any change to that date or to the project's planned scope.
findings.redline_note: Gives the group a termination right if work interferes with the meeting.
findings.compromise_range: Written notice within 30–60 days of plans being confirmed.

findings.quoted_text: All invoiced charges to the master account shall be due in full upon presentation, and the Group waives any right to dispute or withhold payment of billed amounts after receipt of an invoice from the Hotel. Invoices rendered by the Hotel shall be deemed final and binding as to all line items, including room charges, food and beverage costs, facility rentals, service charges, and ancillary fees, unless the Group provides written notice of a discrepancy within the timeframe specified in the master account documentation.
findings.headline: Group waives right to dispute invoices
findings.finding_text: No real dispute window; invoices are final and the timeframe sits in undefined documentation.
findings.cd_standard: Payable on receipt with 30-day dispute window.
findings.proposed_language: If Group's credit is approved, the master account is payable upon receipt of invoice. Group will have thirty (30) days from receipt of the final itemized invoice to review and dispute any charge in good faith before any finance charge accrues on the disputed amount.
findings.redline_note: Provides a defined window to review and dispute invoiced charges.
findings.compromise_range: Finance charge capped at 1–1.5% per month, after a dispute window of at least 30 days.

findings.quoted_text: Should the Group fail to remit full payment of undisputed invoiced amounts by the date due, a monthly finance charge of 1.5% shall accrue on the unpaid balance, calculated from the due date until payment is received in full by the Hotel. This finance charge shall compound monthly and shall be added to the master account statement without further notice.
findings.headline: 1.5% compounding monthly finance charge
findings.finding_text: Finance charge exceeds 1% and compounds, with no legal-maximum cap.
findings.cd_standard: Charge capped at 1% per month or legal maximum, whichever is less, on undisputed balance.
findings.proposed_language: If payment of all undisputed charges is not received within thirty (30) days of the final invoice, a finance charge not to exceed one percent (1.0%) per month, or the maximum allowed by law, whichever is less, will apply to the unpaid, undisputed balance.
findings.redline_note: Caps the finance charge and applies it only to undisputed late balances.
findings.compromise_range: Finance charge capped at 1–1.5% per month, after a dispute window of at least 30 days.

findings.quoted_text: Where the Hotel has not approved credit for the Group, the Hotel may require prepayment in such amount as the Hotel determines to be appropriate before rooms are held, facilities are reserved, or services are rendered. The Group acknowledges that the determination of any required prepayment amount is within the Hotel's sole discretion and shall be binding on the Group upon written notice.
findings.headline: Open-ended prepayment at Hotel's discretion
findings.finding_text: No staged schedule or defined percentage, and no automatic credit if Hotel fails to follow up on credit application.
findings.cd_standard: Auto credit if Hotel fails to send application; staged 25/25/50 deposits if denied.
findings.proposed_language: If Hotel fails to send Group a credit application, or fails to send a written reminder to complete it, Hotel will extend credit to Group. If credit is denied, Group will pay twenty-five percent (25%) of estimated charges within fourteen (14) business days of the denial, twenty-five percent (25%) one (1) month prior to the Event, and fifty percent (50%) three (3) days before the Event.
findings.redline_note: Replaces open-ended prepayment with automatic credit or a defined schedule.
findings.compromise_range: Finance charge capped at 1–1.5% per month, after a dispute window of at least 30 days.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall provide pickup reports to Group showing room occupancy, rate structure, and charges incurred under the room block only upon Group's written request and at the Hotel's convenience, and no regular or periodic reporting shall be deemed a condition of this Agreement. Group shall not have a right to receive weekly, daily, or real-time updates on room block performance, and the Hotel reserves the right to provide such information in summary form and at intervals it deems appropriate.
findings.headline: No regular pickup reports or block reviews
findings.finding_text: Reports only on request; no 24/12-month block reviews or final pickup report deadline.
findings.cd_standard: 24/12-month reviews with adjustment right; weekly pickup reports; final reports within 10 days of departure.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel and Group will review the room block in writing twenty-four (24) months prior to arrival and again twelve (12) months prior to arrival. At Group's sole discretion, Group may increase or decrease the room block by up to ten percent (10%) at each review and twenty percent (20%) cumulatively, at the group rate; the resulting block becomes Group's room block commitment for purposes of the attrition clause. Hotel will provide Group a weekly guestroom pickup report starting sixty (60) days prior to the cutoff date, and final room pickup reports with supporting documentation within ten (10) days of departure.
findings.redline_note: Adds scheduled block reviews and regular pickup reporting.

findings.quoted_text: Within ninety (90) days following the conclusion of Group's event on April 16, 2027, the Hotel shall provide Group with a comprehensive post-event report detailing final room block results, attendee counts, revenue by rate category, and itemized charges for all services rendered.
findings.headline: Post-event report due in 90 days, narrow content
findings.finding_text: Report arrives later than 30 days and omits F&B, AV, bandwidth and exhibitor detail; late delivery does not delay payment.
findings.cd_standard: Full post-event report within 30 days; late delivery may delay master account payment.
findings.proposed_language: Within thirty (30) days of departure, Hotel will provide a full post-event report, including rooms actualized, a reservation pace report starting 90 days prior to cutoff, suite and double-occupancy usage, a food and beverage revenue recap by Group and affiliate functions, outlet and other spend by attendees on room and master account charges, audio-visual spend, internet bandwidth usage, and exhibitor fees and revenue; failure to provide this report within thirty (30) days may delay payment of the master account.
findings.redline_note: Shortens the report deadline and broadens its content.

findings.quoted_text: Group shall have no right to audit, inspect, or verify the Hotel's room block records, reservation systems, or internal accounting related to Group's event, and Group waives any audit rights it might otherwise possess under applicable law or contract principles.
findings.headline: Room block audit right waived
findings.finding_text: No audit and no crediting of miscoded rooms to pickup.
findings.cd_standard: No-cost audit, joint or independent; miscoded rooms credited to pickup regardless of rate.
findings.proposed_language: At Group's request and at no cost, Hotel will compare its in-house guest list against Group's registration list, either jointly with a representative of Group or by permitting a ConferenceDirect or Group representative to do so independently, and Group will keep the list confidential. Any guest room occupied by an individual on Group's registration list but not coded to Group within Hotel's system, including rooms booked at qualified brand-associate or business rates or through Internet distribution channels, will be credited to Group's pickup regardless of the rate paid or reservation method.
findings.redline_note: Gives the group a no-cost room block audit and pickup credit for miscoded rooms.

findings.quoted_text: The Group shall deposit with the Hotel the sum of $25,000.00 as security for the faithful performance of all obligations under this Agreement, including but not limited to the payment of room charges, the satisfaction of all food and beverage minimums, the performance of all other financial covenants, and the absence of damage to the Hotel's property caused by the Group's guests or representatives.
findings.headline: Deposit secures all financial obligations, not just damage
findings.finding_text: The deposit is tied to every financial covenant; its size should also be confirmed as reasonable for the event.
findings.cd_standard: Reasonable deposit, not used for attrition or F&B minimums.
findings.proposed_language: The Group shall deposit with the Hotel the sum of $25,000.00 as security for the absence of damage to the Hotel's property caused by the Group's guests or representatives.
findings.redline_note: Limits the deposit's purpose to property damage.
findings.compromise_range: Refunded within 30–45 days of departure.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel may apply the security deposit, or such portion thereof as necessary, against any attrition charges, food and beverage shortfalls, damages to the Hotel's premises, incidental costs, outstanding room charges, service failures, cancellation penalties, or any other sum that the Group owes to the Hotel under this Agreement or arising from the Group's occupancy and use of the Hotel's facilities.
findings.headline: Deposit may offset attrition, F&B and cancellation charges
findings.finding_text: The deposit can be drawn for unrelated charges.
findings.cd_standard: Deposit may not be applied toward attrition, cancellation, or F&B shortfalls.
findings.proposed_language: The Hotel may apply the security deposit only against specific, documented damage to the Hotel's premises caused by Group or its attendees beyond normal wear and tear. The deposit may not be applied toward attrition, cancellation, or F&B minimum shortfalls.
findings.redline_note: Restricts use of the deposit to documented property damage.
findings.compromise_range: Refunded within 30–45 days of departure.

findings.quoted_text: Any remaining balance of the security deposit shall be refunded to the Group within ninety (90) days following the last day of the Event, provided that all invoices have been paid in full, all obligations have been satisfied, and no claims for damages are then pending.
findings.headline: Refund takes 90 days and is conditional
findings.finding_text: Refund window is three times the standard and depends on conditions beyond damage.
findings.cd_standard: Full refund within 30 days unless itemized, documented damage.
findings.proposed_language: Any security deposit collected under this Agreement will be refunded in full within thirty (30) days of the event's conclusion unless the Hotel provides Group with an itemized accounting of specific, documented damage caused by Group or its attendees beyond normal wear and tear.
findings.redline_note: Shortens the refund period and ties withholding to itemized damage.
findings.compromise_range: Refunded within 30–45 days of departure.

findings.quoted_text: Group shall engage for all services at the Hotel only vendors appointed exclusively by the Hotel or operating as part of the Hotel's in-house service divisions, and Group shall not retain, contract with, or permit on the Hotel's premises any outside vendor, supplier, decorator, caterer, audiovisual provider, florist, musician, photographer, or other service provider without the Hotel's prior written consent. Group's use of any outside vendor in violation of this requirement shall incur a surcharge of $2,500.00 for each such engagement.
findings.headline: In-house vendors mandatory with per-vendor surcharge
findings.finding_text: Group must use Hotel vendors or pay a fee for each outside vendor.
findings.cd_standard: Vendor of Group's choice at no fee; in-house not mandatory.
findings.proposed_language: Group reserves the right to utilize the supplier of its choice, at no additional service fee or surcharge, for services or rentals including but not limited to audio-visual, exhibit decorating, security, floral, transportation, and tours. Hotel's in-house vendors are not mandatory for any service category.
findings.redline_note: Lets the group choose its vendors without a surcharge.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group engage an outside vendor in contravention of this clause, Group shall pay the stated surcharge in addition to any costs incurred by the Hotel in addressing the unauthorized service provision. Such payment shall be invoiced separately and shall be due within fifteen (15) days of invoice. The Hotel's acceptance of payment shall not constitute a waiver of this requirement for future events or services.
findings.headline: Surcharge plus Hotel costs for using outside vendor
findings.finding_text: Penalty compounds the opt-out fee with open-ended costs.
findings.cd_standard: No fee or surcharge for outside vendors.
findings.proposed_language: No fee, surcharge, or other charge will apply to Group's use of outside vendors.
findings.redline_note: Removes charges for using outside vendors.

findings.quoted_text: Group may terminate this Agreement only for material breach by the Hotel that remains uncured thirty (30) days after written notice. Termination for such cause does not relieve Group of liability for damages, including lost profit, diminution in value, and consequential loss incurred by the Hotel as a result of Group's election to terminate. The Hotel shall calculate all such damages from its books and records and shall provide Group with a detailed accounting upon request. Group shall pay such damages within thirty (30) days of invoice.
findings.headline: Only uncured breach allows exit, and still costs damages
findings.finding_text: None of the listed no-liability causes apply and Group owes Hotel damages even when Hotel is in breach.
findings.cd_standard: No-liability termination with refund within 5 days on listed causes.
findings.proposed_language: Group may terminate this Agreement without liability, and Hotel will refund all deposits and prepayments within five (5) days, upon any of the following: (a) force majeure as defined in this Agreement; (b) Group's determination that COVID-19 or any other infectious disease outbreak, epidemic, or pandemic is affecting Group's ability to hold the Event as intended; (c) a labor dispute involving Hotel's employees, including an expired collective bargaining agreement, picketing, strike, or lockout, arising within ninety (90) days of or during the Event; (d) a material change in Hotel's ownership, management company, or brand affiliation, or Hotel's bankruptcy or foreclosure; (e) renovation or remodeling that Group determines will interfere with its meeting, or a change to a new build's operational date or scope; (f) a reduction in Hotel's facilities or services for which no mutually agreeable alternative is reached within thirty (30) days; (g) the convention center or overflow hotels on which the Event depends not being open, available, and fully operational over the Event dates; or (h) the adoption of state or local legislation that permits discrimination against attendees on any basis protected under this Agreement.
findings.redline_note: Adds defined termination rights with prompt refund.

findings.quoted_text: Notwithstanding the grounds upon which Group effects termination, whether for cause, convenience, or otherwise, any and all termination by Group shall be deemed and treated as a cancellation subject to the cancellation damages scale set forth in this Agreement. Group acknowledges that termination and cancellation are not distinct events but rather the same occurrence governed by a single damages regime. The cancellation scale shall apply to every termination regardless of its cause, and Group waives any argument that termination for cause stands outside the cancellation framework. The Hotel's right to cancellation damages shall not be diminished by Group's assertion that the Hotel committed a material breach.
findings.headline: Termination for cause triggers cancellation damages
findings.finding_text: Even a justified termination is charged on the liquidated damages scale.
findings.cd_standard: Termination for cause separate from and not triggering the cancellation scale.
findings.proposed_language: None of the foregoing terminations triggers the liquidated-damages calculation in the cancellation clause. Termination for cause is distinct from cancellation.
findings.redline_note: Separates termination for cause from the cancellation damages scale.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall use commercially reasonable efforts to provide written notice to the Group in the event of a change in the Hotel's brand affiliation, management company, ownership, or controlling interest; provided, however, that the Hotel shall provide such notice no later than ninety (90) days prior to the effective date of any such change, to the extent practicable and permitted by the Hotel's corporate counsel and applicable law.
findings.headline: Change notice is efforts-based and qualified
findings.finding_text: Notice is only on commercially reasonable efforts and subject to practicability, not a firm duty.
findings.cd_standard: Written notice within 30 days of the change or filing.
findings.proposed_language: Should Hotel undergo a material change in ownership, management company, or brand affiliation, or file for bankruptcy, or have foreclosure occur, Hotel will inform Group in writing within thirty (30) days of such change or filing.
findings.redline_note: Makes written notice of changes a firm obligation.
findings.compromise_range: Hotel notice within 30–60 days of the change. Group's termination window of at least 30 days after notice.

findings.quoted_text: Upon receipt of notice of a material change in brand, management, or ownership, the Group shall have the right to terminate this Agreement by providing written notice to the Hotel within ten (10) days of receipt of such notice, and such termination shall be effective upon receipt by the Hotel. Failure to provide termination notice within the ten (10) day period shall be deemed acceptance of the change and waiver of the Group's right to terminate on this ground.
findings.headline: Only 10 days to terminate, no refund
findings.finding_text: Short window and no refund of deposits.
findings.cd_standard: 30 days to terminate without liability; refund within 5 days.
findings.proposed_language: Group may, at its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement without liability within thirty (30) days of receiving that notice. Hotel will refund all deposits and prepayments made by Group within five (5) days of the notice of termination.
findings.redline_note: Extends the termination window and provides a prompt refund.
findings.compromise_range: Hotel notice within 30–60 days of the change. Group's termination window of at least 30 days after notice.

findings.quoted_text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, the Group acknowledges that the Hotel may be subject to bankruptcy, foreclosure, receivership, or other insolvency proceedings, and that such events shall not trigger any notice requirement, termination right, or remedy available to the Group.
findings.headline: Insolvency events carry no notice or exit right
findings.finding_text: Bankruptcy or foreclosure gives Group no notice or termination right.
findings.cd_standard: Bankruptcy or foreclosure covered by notice and termination right.
findings.proposed_language: Notice and termination rights under this Section apply equally to Hotel's bankruptcy, foreclosure, receivership, or other insolvency proceedings.
findings.redline_note: Extends notice and termination rights to insolvency events.
findings.compromise_range: Hotel notice within 30–60 days of the change. Group's termination window of at least 30 days after notice.

findings.quoted_text: Should the National Weather Service issue a hurricane watch or named tropical storm warning that affects the Baltimore, Maryland area during the seventy-two (72) hours preceding the event arrival date of April 12, 2027, or during the event period of April 12-16, 2027, Group shall have the right to cancel this agreement without incurring liquidated damages, provided that such cancellation notice is delivered to the Hotel in writing within twenty-four (24) hours of the issuance of such warning by the National Weather Service. Group's cancellation notice must cite the specific National Weather Service warning upon which the cancellation is based and must be received by the Hotel's Director of Sales or designated event manager. This named storm cancellation right shall expire and become unavailable to Group if cancellation notice is not received by the Hotel within the twenty-four (24) hour window following the warning issuance.
findings.headline: 24-hour storm window, Group-only right
findings.finding_text: Tight notice window, formal citation requirements, and no right for either party on a forecast.
findings.cd_standard: Either party may cancel without liability when a named storm is forecast within 72 hours, regardless of damage.
findings.proposed_language: In the event a named storm (hurricane, tropical storm) is forecast to affect the Hotel's location within 72 hours of any event date, either party may cancel the affected portion of the event without liability upon written or verbal (followed by written) notice, regardless of whether the storm ultimately causes physical damage to the Hotel.
findings.redline_note: Allows either party to cancel without liability on a storm forecast.

findings.quoted_text: Should Group invoke the named storm cancellation right, Group shall forfeit the deposit paid to the Hotel, which shall be retained by the Hotel as partial compensation for the Hotel's lost revenue and costs incurred in preparation for the event. The Hotel and Group may mutually agree to reschedule the event at a later date, in which case the Hotel shall apply the forfeited deposit as a credit toward the deposit required for the rescheduled event, provided that all other terms of the agreement shall be negotiated anew. If no reschedule occurs, the Hotel shall issue no refund of the forfeited deposit to Group.
findings.headline: Deposit forfeited when cancelling for a named storm
findings.finding_text: A storm cancellation costs the deposit, so the right is not liability-free.
findings.cd_standard: Storm cancellation without liability.
findings.proposed_language: Should Group or Hotel cancel under this Section, Hotel will refund all deposits and prepayments within five (5) days of the notice of cancellation. The parties may mutually agree to reschedule the event, in which case Hotel will apply the deposit as a credit toward the rescheduled event.
findings.redline_note: Refunds deposits on a storm cancellation, with an option to reschedule.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall not be obligated to provide the Group with advance written notice regarding the expiration date, renewal status, or proposed modification of any collective bargaining agreement, union contract, or labor accord to which the Hotel is a party. The Group acknowledges that information regarding labor relations, union negotiations, and collective bargaining agreement timelines is confidential business information of the Hotel and shall not be disclosed to the Group unless the Hotel, in its sole discretion, determines that such disclosure is appropriate.
findings.headline: No notice of labor contract expirations or disputes
findings.finding_text: Hotel withholds CBA timelines and has no duty to report disputes.
findings.cd_standard: One year's notice of CBA expirations; notice within 10 working days of any dispute.
findings.proposed_language: One (1) year in advance, or within thirty (30) days of signing this Agreement if that is later, Hotel will provide Group in writing a list of all collective bargaining agreement expiration dates for the ensuing year. Hotel will notify Group in writing within ten (10) working days after becoming aware of any labor dispute involving Hotel's employees, including picketing, an expired labor contract, or an existing or impending strike, lockout, or boycott.
findings.redline_note: Requires advance notice of labor contract expirations and prompt notice of disputes.
findings.compromise_range: Notice of contract expiry 6–12 months ahead. Cancellation without liability for disputes within 60–90 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: In the event of a labor dispute, strike, work stoppage, lockout, labor action, or other labor-related event affecting the Hotel or its operations, no cancellation window or notice period is defined herein, and the Group shall have no right to cancel this Agreement based upon the occurrence or threatened occurrence of any such labor-related event. The Group's rights and remedies in the event of a labor dispute shall be limited to such remedies as are explicitly stated in this Agreement.
findings.headline: No right to cancel over a strike or lockout
findings.finding_text: Group is locked in even during a strike or expired union contract.
findings.cd_standard: Cancel without liability if contract expires, picketing, strike or lockout within 90 days of or during the event.
findings.proposed_language: If, within ninety (90) days prior to or during the Event, Hotel's contract with its union employees has expired, picketing occurs, or a strike or lockout occurs, Group may cancel this Agreement by written notice without liability, regardless of whether Hotel is able to perform.
findings.redline_note: Gives the group a cancellation right if a labor dispute arises near the event.
findings.compromise_range: Notice of contract expiry 6–12 months ahead. Cancellation without liability for disputes within 60–90 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: The Group acknowledges and agrees that the occurrence of any labor dispute, strike, work stoppage, lockout, job action, or labor-related disruption at the Hotel shall not relieve, excuse, or reduce the Group's obligations under this Agreement, and shall not give rise to any claim for damages, abatement of charges, rate reduction, or credit. The Group shall remain obligated to pay all room charges, food and beverage minimums, facility rental fees, and all other amounts due under this Agreement notwithstanding the occurrence or impact of any labor-related event.
findings.headline: Full payment obligations continue during labor action
findings.finding_text: Group pays everything despite disruption, with no refund of deposits.
findings.cd_standard: Deposits promptly refunded; clause supersedes all other provisions.
findings.proposed_language: Any deposits or payments made by Group will be promptly refunded. This clause supersedes all other provisions of this Agreement.
findings.redline_note: Refunds deposits on a labor-related cancellation and gives this clause priority.
findings.compromise_range: Notice of contract expiry 6–12 months ahead. Cancellation without liability for disputes within 60–90 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel retains the absolute right to sell rooms to the general public at any rate, including rates below the rate offered to Group. The Hotel's pricing to the public shall not be limited by, constrained by, or subordinate to the rate offered to Group, and Group waives any claim that lower public rates violate any rate parity or rate protection provision.
findings.headline: Hotel may undercut group rate freely
findings.finding_text: No guarantee against lower rates and no protection against other groups' lower rates.
findings.cd_standard: No lower rate during event dates except qualified rates; Group rate no higher than other groups within 7 days either side.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel guarantees it will not sell guestrooms at a rate lower than Group's contracted group rate during the Event dates, with the exception of qualified rates (government, airline, and contracted corporate negotiated rates). Hotel further agrees that Group's rate will be no higher than the group rate given to any other group over the period from seven (7) days before through seven (7) days after the room block dates.
findings.redline_note: Guarantees the group rate is the lowest available, with limited exceptions.
findings.compromise_range: Group rate no higher than other groups' rates within 3–7 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: Should the Hotel identify that it has sold rooms to the general public at a rate lower than Group's negotiated rate, any rate adjustment applied to Group's block shall be effective only for future reservations made after the Hotel has identified and approved the lower rate. No retroactive adjustment to Group's rate shall apply to reservations already confirmed prior to the date on which the lower rate is identified. Group's liability for rooms reserved at the original rate shall not be reduced or eliminated by the Hotel's subsequent discovery of lower public rates.
findings.headline: No retroactive adjustment to lower rate
findings.finding_text: Already confirmed reservations stay at the higher rate.
findings.cd_standard: Adjust rate for all prior reservations to match.
findings.proposed_language: If Hotel offers a lower guestroom rate, Hotel will adjust the rate for all prior reservations in Group's block to match and make the adjusted rate available to all Group attendees.
findings.redline_note: Applies any lower rate to existing reservations as well.
findings.compromise_range: Group rate no higher than other groups' rates within 3–7 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: Any rate adjustment determined by the Hotel to apply to Group's block shall be treated as a non-commissionable rate for purposes of Group's commission or rebate structure under this Agreement. An adjusted rate shall not count toward Group's room block pickup calculations, occupancy targets, or any other metric used to measure Group's performance against block commitments. The adjusted rate shall be invoiced at the new rate, but the Hotel shall make no adjustment to complimentary rooms, attrition calculations, or other block-based benefits.
findings.headline: Adjusted rooms lose commission and pickup credit
findings.finding_text: Rooms at an adjusted rate do not count to pickup, increasing attrition and reducing concessions.
findings.cd_standard: Commission on contracted rate; rooms creditable to pickup, complimentary rooms, attrition and other concessions.
findings.proposed_language: Commission will be paid on the contracted rate regardless of any rate adjustment, and such rooms remain creditable toward Group's pickup, complimentary-room credits, attrition, and any other concession based on pickup.
findings.redline_note: Keeps adjusted-rate rooms commissionable and counted toward pickup.
findings.compromise_range: Group rate no higher than other groups' rates within 3–7 days of the event.

findings.quoted_text: A service charge and gratuity shall be added to all food and beverage, banquet, and room charges, and the terms 'gratuity' and 'service charge' shall be used interchangeably throughout this Agreement and are not separately defined. The combined gratuity and service charge shall be automatically applied at the rate of twenty-four percent (24%) of the subtotal of all covered charges before tax. Group shall not dispute this automatic application, and the Service Charge shall be due and payable by Group without exception or reduction.
findings.headline: Gratuity and service charge merged and applied to room charges
findings.finding_text: Terms undefined, one blended percentage, and applied to room charges.
findings.cd_standard: Separately defined gratuity and service charge with both percentages confirmed; none on meeting room rental or labor-fee equipment.
findings.proposed_language: Eighteen percent (18%) of the food and beverage total, plus applicable tax, will be added to Group's account as a gratuity and fully distributed to the servers, and where applicable, bussers and bartenders assigned to the Event. Any service charge of six percent (6%), plus applicable tax, is separate from gratuity, is not distributed as a tip, and is retained by Hotel to cover the discretionary costs of the Event. Both percentages are confirmed in this Agreement. Hotel will not add a gratuity or service charge to meeting room rental fees or to any rented equipment that also carries a labor fee.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall determine in its sole discretion the allocation and distribution of any gratuity and service charge collected from Group. The Hotel may retain the gratuity and service charge as its own revenue or may distribute a portion or all of it to service staff at the Hotel's election. No representation is made regarding the destination of these funds, and Group waives any right to direct, approve, or inquire into the allocation thereof. The amount due from Group remains unchanged regardless of how the Hotel applies the collected funds.
findings.headline: Hotel may keep gratuity as its own revenue
findings.finding_text: Gratuity may be retained rather than paid to staff.
findings.cd_standard: Gratuity fully distributed to staff who worked the event; service charge disclosed as Hotel revenue.
findings.proposed_language: The gratuity will be fully distributed to the servers, and where applicable, bussers and bartenders assigned to the Event. The service charge is Hotel's own revenue and is not a tip.
findings.redline_note: Requires gratuity to go to staff and identifies the service charge as Hotel revenue.

findings.quoted_text: These charges shall appear separately on all invoices and statements, but the distinction is for accounting purposes only and does not imply that the service charge is excluded from the total amount due from Group.
findings.headline: Distinction between charges treated as accounting only
findings.finding_text: The separation of gratuity and service charge is denied any meaning.
findings.cd_standard: Gratuity and service charge clearly and separately defined.
findings.proposed_language: These charges shall appear separately on all invoices and statements, and the gratuity and the service charge are distinct charges as defined in this Agreement.
findings.redline_note: Confirms the two charges are distinct and shown separately.

findings.quoted_text: Upon release of any room inventory or function space by Group, whether through attrition, cancellation, or other reduction of Group's commitment, the Hotel shall have no obligation to attempt to resell such released inventory or function space, nor shall the Hotel be required to undertake any specific actions, marketing efforts, or promotional activities directed toward filling released space. The Hotel's decision to attempt resale, the means by which resale is pursued, the pricing at which space is offered, the priority given to such resale efforts as against other Hotel business, and the duration of any resale efforts shall be entirely within the Hotel's sole discretion. Group shall not have standing to challenge the Hotel's decisions regarding resale efforts, marketing strategies, or the business judgment exercised in connection with released inventory.
findings.headline: No duty to resell released rooms and space
findings.finding_text: Hotel can leave released inventory unsold and still collect full damages.
findings.cd_standard: Documented duty to resell via all channels; damages due 30 days after meeting dates with evidence of mitigation.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will undertake all reasonable efforts to resell canceled rooms and food and beverage functions. Hotel will document in writing its efforts to market the dates proactively through all group and transient channels, including offering the canceled rooms through Hotel's reservations department. Cancellation damages, if any, are due thirty (30) days after the meeting dates, provided Hotel supplies reasonable evidence of its mitigation efforts and that the rooms and space held for Group went unsold.
findings.redline_note: Requires documented efforts to resell released rooms and space.
findings.compromise_range: Cancellation damages due 30–60 days after the meeting dates.

findings.quoted_text: Any revenue generated by the Hotel from the resale or release of rooms or function space originally committed to Group shall be retained in full by the Hotel as additional revenue beyond what Group owes under the terms of this agreement, including without limitation attrition charges, cancellation damages, or any other fees or charges assessed herein. Resale proceeds shall not be credited, offset, or applied against Group's outstanding obligations to the Hotel, and the Hotel shall have no duty to track, account for, or allocate resale revenue in any manner.
findings.headline: Resale proceeds kept in addition to damages
findings.finding_text: Hotel double-recovers on resold rooms.
findings.cd_standard: Resale revenue credited against damages, up to full damages.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will credit revenues from the resale of canceled rooms and food and beverage functions against any cancellation or attrition damages owed by Group, not to exceed the full amount of such damages. For purposes of this calculation, the last rooms contracted or sold by Hotel during the meeting period after receiving notice of cancellation will be credited toward Group's unused block.
findings.redline_note: Credits resale revenue against any damages owed.
findings.compromise_range: Cancellation damages due 30–60 days after the meeting dates.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel's resale efforts, the terms at which resale accommodations are offered to other customers, the identity of parties to whom space is resold, the rate at which such space is resold, and the complete records related to all resale transactions shall not be open to Group for inspection, audit, or verification of any kind. Group shall have no right to request, receive, or review documentation concerning the Hotel's resale activities, and Group shall waive any claim that the Hotel has failed to mitigate damages through inadequate resale efforts or unfavorable resale pricing.
findings.headline: No access to resale records; mitigation claims waived
findings.finding_text: Group cannot verify mitigation or challenge it.
findings.cd_standard: Records, including occupancy reports, available to Group on request.
findings.proposed_language: All Hotel records relating to mitigation, including actual occupancy reports, will be made available to Group upon request.
findings.redline_note: Gives the group access to mitigation records.
findings.compromise_range: Cancellation damages due 30–60 days after the meeting dates.

findings.headline: No commission to ConferenceDirect
findings.finding_text: The contract has no commission provision for ConferenceDirect.
findings.cd_standard: 10% commission on all actualized room revenue within 30 days of departure, non-cancelable, plus 10% of liquidated damages.
findings.proposed_language: All rates confirmed in this Agreement are commissionable at ten percent (10%) to ConferenceDirect, LLC. Hotel will pay commission to ConferenceDirect on all actualized room revenue, regardless of rate paid and including all rooms outside the block, within thirty (30) days of Group's departure, whether or not the master account has been paid in full. Hotel agrees that Group could not have negotiated more favorable room rates, terms, and concessions had Group negotiated directly with Hotel rather than through ConferenceDirect, and Hotel and Group agree that commission for this booking is non-cancelable and non-transferable to another party or agency. Commission on any additional rooms or amendments will be no less than ten percent (10%) or the amount in this Agreement, whichever is higher, regardless of room rate paid. Should the standard hotel or brand commission percentage increase before the Event, the higher percentage will apply; should Hotel change management company or brand affiliation, the new management will honor the existing commission, or the new brand's commission if higher. Hotel will pay ConferenceDirect ten percent (10%) of any liquidated damages paid by Group within ten (10) days of receiving them.
findings.redline_note: Adds the commission terms for the group's agent.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel shall assign all function space for the Group's use during the Event at the Hotel's sole discretion, and no function room is named or reserved in this Agreement. The Group acknowledges that the Hotel retains the right to change any function space assignment at any time by written notice to the Group's authorized representative, provided that such reassignment shall not materially diminish the aggregate square footage or suitability of space made available to the Group. Any audio-visual, catering, or other services contracted for a particular function space shall transfer to the reassigned space, and the Group shall not be entitled to any reduction in charges, waiver of fees, or claim for damages by reason of any such change.
findings.headline: Rooms unnamed and Hotel may reassign freely
findings.finding_text: No named rooms, square footage or ceiling heights, and unilateral changes.
findings.cd_standard: Each room named with minimum square footage and ceiling height; no change without written consent of both parties.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will specify each function space assignment, minimum square footage, and ceiling height requirement in this Agreement, including the spaces listed in Exhibit A (minimum square footage [X] and ceiling height [X] for each). No change will be made to the function space assignments without the written consent of both parties.
findings.redline_note: Names the function rooms with size and height, and requires mutual consent to change.

findings.quoted_text: The Group shall pay all applicable rental charges for meeting rooms and function space utilized during the Event, calculated according to the Hotel's standard pricing schedule in effect at the time of booking. Such charges shall be stated separately on the Group's master account and shall be due and payable in accordance with the billing and payment terms set forth elsewhere in this Agreement. The Hotel shall provide no credit, reduction, or waiver of function space rental fees regardless of Group's use of in-house audio-visual services, catering packages, or other Hotel services.
findings.headline: Meeting room rental charged; no amenities included
findings.finding_text: Rental is charged on meeting space and no included equipment is promised.
findings.cd_standard: Rental waived on program agenda space; mic, podium, power, lighting and HVAC at no charge.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will hold the meeting and function space set out in this Agreement, with room rental charges waived. Meeting space outlined in Group's program agenda will be provided on a complimentary basis. Hotel will provide in each meeting room, at no charge, one wired microphone, a podium, power (including existing power outlets), proper lighting, and HVAC.
findings.redline_note: Waives meeting room rental and includes basic equipment in each room.

findings.headline: No remedy if hotel closes facilities or cuts service
findings.finding_text: The contract has no clause on closures or service reductions.
findings.cd_standard: Equal alternatives at Hotel's expense; cancel without liability if none agreed within 30 days.
findings.proposed_language: If Hotel closes or limits the hours of service of any current restaurant, health club, spa, fitness facility, contracted meeting space, or other hospitality venue or facility by more than twenty-five percent (25%) of its published capacity or full-service offering, or limits, restricts, or reduces the guest-to-staff service ratio of its housekeeping, restaurant, banquet, maintenance and engineering, safety and security, or any other service in a manner a hotel industry executive would agree is material, Hotel will first have the option to provide equal alternative facilities or services, mutually agreeable and solely at Hotel's expense. Should no mutually agreeable alternative be reached within thirty (30) days, Group may cancel this Agreement without liability upon written notice to Hotel, or the parties may instead modify this Agreement on mutually agreed terms.
findings.redline_note: Adds a remedy if facilities or services are closed or reduced.
findings.compromise_range: Closures or cuts of more than 25–35% trigger the alternatives duty.

findings.quoted_text: Each individual attendee's reservation shall be held at the rate negotiated for the Group, provided that the reservation remains in the attendee's original name. A name change on any individual reservation shall be treated as a new reservation at the Hotel's prevailing rate for comparable accommodations on the relevant dates, and the attendee shall be responsible for any rate difference between the Group rate and the prevailing rate.
findings.headline: Name changes lose the group rate; no confirmations
findings.finding_text: Attendees lose the group rate on a name change, and no confirmation timing is stated.
findings.cd_standard: Name changes at group rate up to arrival; confirmations at no charge within 4 days (2 business days inside 30 days).
findings.proposed_language: Each individual attendee's reservation shall be held at the rate negotiated for the Group. Name changes may be made to room reservations at the group rate at any time up to and including the arrival date. Upon request, Hotel will send each registered guest confirmation of their reservation, and of any change to it, at no charge within four (4) days of receiving the information, or within two (2) business days if the request is received within thirty (30) days of arrival.
findings.redline_note: Keeps the group rate on name changes and adds timely confirmations.

findings.quoted_text: An attendee who fails to arrive on the first night of his or her reservation shall be deemed to have no-showed, and the Hotel shall cancel the whole remaining reservation for that attendee without further notice or obligation to the attendee or the Group. Such cancellation shall release all rooms reserved for that attendee for the balance of the event period and shall eliminate any further claim by that attendee or the Group to those rooms.
findings.headline: First-night no-show cancels entire stay
findings.finding_text: Late arrivals lose remaining nights and rooms.
findings.cd_standard: No-shows reinstated for the following night at the same rate.
findings.proposed_language: Hotel will reinstate no-shows for the following night at the rate of their existing reservation unless Group directs otherwise.
findings.redline_note: Reinstates no-show reservations for the following night.

findings.quoted_text: Individual reservations may be cancelled by the attendee or by the Group, without penalty or charge, only if written notice of cancellation is received by the Hotel's group reservations department more than seventy-two hours prior to the scheduled arrival date of the attendee. Individual reservations cancelled within seventy-two hours of arrival are charged one night's room and tax, which charge shall be non-refundable and shall be the sole remedy available to the Hotel for such late cancellation.
findings.headline: 72-hour cancellation deadline and no credit to attrition
findings.finding_text: Deadline is far earlier than 6 pm on arrival day; retained cancellation money isn't credited to attrition.
findings.cd_standard: Cancel without fee until 6 pm day of arrival; deposits refundable with 3 working days' notice; cancellation money credited to attrition.
findings.proposed_language: No cancellation fee will be assessed for any room cancelled before 6:00 p.m. on the day of arrival. Individual reservations cancelled after that time are charged one night's room and tax, which shall be the sole remedy available to the Hotel for such late cancellation. Any individual reservation deposit will be refunded if notice of cancellation is received at least three (3) working days before arrival, and any individual cancellation money Hotel receives will be credited toward any attrition damages owed by Group.
findings.redline_note: Extends the free cancellation period and credits retained cancellation money to attrition.

findings.quoted_text: Staffing at food and beverage functions, including the assignment of servers, bartenders, runners, and other service personnel, is at the Hotel's discretion and shall be determined by the Hotel based on the number of attendees, the complexity of the menu, the duration of the function, and the Hotel's operational requirements. The Hotel shall ensure adequate staffing to provide professional service, but the Hotel's determination of adequate staffing levels shall not be subject to challenge by the Group and shall be final.
findings.headline: No guaranteed staffing ratios
findings.finding_text: Staffing is at Hotel's discretion and unchallengeable.
findings.cd_standard: 1 server per 25 (plated breakfast), 20 (plated lunch/dinner), 40/30 buffets; bartender per 75 hosted, 100 cash.
findings.proposed_language: At all meal functions, Hotel will provide at least one server for every twenty-five (25) guests at a plated breakfast and every twenty (20) guests at a plated lunch or dinner, and one server for every forty (40) guests at a buffet breakfast and every thirty (30) guests at a buffet lunch or dinner, with no extra service or labor charge for these ratios. At all functions where alcohol is served, Hotel will provide no fewer than one (1) bartender for every seventy-five (75) guests at hosted bars and one (1) bartender for every one hundred (100) guests at cash bars, with no bartender or service fees.
findings.redline_note: Sets minimum server and bartender ratios.
findings.compromise_range: Staffing ratios up to 20% looser than the standard, e.g. one server per 30 guests at plated breakfasts.

findings.quoted_text: The Hotel charges labor and bartender fees on Group's food and beverage functions, calculated on the basis of estimated attendance, the scope of service, and the Hotel's then-current labor rates, which fees shall be itemized separately on the Group's invoice and shall be payable as part of the total food and beverage charges due under this Agreement. Labor fees shall include compensation for all service staff, supervisory personnel, and setup and breakdown labor, and the Group shall have no right to engage outside service providers or to reduce these fees by providing its own staff.
findings.headline: Labor and bartender fees charged on all functions
findings.finding_text: Fees apply to every function with no ratio-based exemption.
findings.cd_standard: No labor or service fees except for functions under 25 people.
findings.proposed_language: There will be no special labor or service fees for any Group food or beverage function, except that functions of fewer than twenty-five (25) people will incur a labor fee of $150.
findings.redline_note: Removes labor and bartender fees except for very small functions.
